prompt_analysis.positive_prompt_used: photorealistic close-up portrait, sharp focus, detailed skin texture, realistic human anatomy, natural lighting, high resolution, 8k, ultra-detailed, film grain, subtle imperfections
prompt_analysis.negative_prompt_used: blur, haze, fog, soft focus, doll, anime, plastic, low quality, bad anatomy, malformed hands, disfigured, oversmooth, airbrushed, cartoon, painting, drawing, illustration, text, watermark, signature
prompt_analysis.detail: The phrase 'close-up portrait' directly instructs the model to generate a close-up. Combined with 'detailed skin texture' and 'realistic human anatomy', the model is pushed toward extreme facial/eye detail rather than a full-frame scene.

negative_prompt_analysis.detail: The negative prompt blocks style issues (blur, doll, anime) but does not block composition issues (macro crops, isolated body parts).

workflow_patch_analysis.detail: Quality checks include 'human_present' and 'micro_detail_present' but no 'full_frame_required' or 'scene_context_visible'.

generation_contract_analysis.detail: The corrective generation contract enforced exactly-one-generation and stop-after-generation, but did not specify the output must be a full-frame production candidate. The contract quality_target was 'quality_candidate_only', which the system interpreted as allowing any quality-focused output including body-part crops.

reference_usage_analysis.detail: The eye-closeup quality reference was registered for quality calibration (skin micro-detail, eye naturalness). However, the prompt designer incorporated 'close-up portrait' into the positive prompt, effectively using the quality reference's composition as the target composition. The body_part_reference_scope_guard existed but was not enforced at prompt submission time.

pipeline_failure: Corrective constraints were interpreted as composition target instead of quality constraints.
